External registries, CMOs, administrators, platforms, courts and approved representatives remain authoritative for their own records and decisions.
All intelligence use requires versioned consent, permitted purpose, jurisdiction, retention, cohort and output controls.
Pseudonymized data remains protected data; no output may be called anonymous without a documented re-identification assessment.

Collective bargaining, collective licensing, representation, CMO-like activity and labor organizing require separate counsel, entity, mandate and jurisdiction approval.
No automated contract or legal advice; outputs are educational intelligence with source, version, confidence, limitations and review dates.
No enforcement, eligibility, ranking or punishment decision may be based on participation in a benchmark or negotiation group.
Every benchmark release must pass privacy, competition, source freshness, cohort concentration, quality and approval gates.
All migrations and APIs require RLS, least privilege, restricted storage, idempotency, audit logs, kill switches and tested rollback.
Every task requires repository-mapped implementation and test evidence before completion.
